messages.body_plain:
Looks like its hard wired into the plot function, but I'd like to be able to disable the Legend

discrimcohort <- seqecmpgroup(fsubseq, group = cohort, method = "bonferroni")
plot(discrimcohort)



Regards
Ken

messages.body_plain:
Hi Ken,

The plot function (plot.subseqelistchisq) has been updated in TraMineR development version 2.3-3 available on R-Forge https://r-forge.r-project.org/R/?group_id=743 . This development version will be released as v 2.2-3 on the CRAN in the next weeks.

The plot function gains an argument with.legend that is set as TRUE by default.

Regards,
Gilbert
